verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs describe configurable scorers used within evals and playgrounds (LLM-as-a-judge style scorers), online scoring of production traces, and code examples show custom scorer configuration (e.g., LevenshteinScorer swapped in evals). Docs explicitly mention 'author scorers' via CLI/MCP and building scorers with Loop, supporting configurability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming 'LLM-as-a-judge' scorer templates/library and independent hands-on validation of judge configurability beyond vendor docs.
